title: Get notebook cell run result
description: Read the durable state of a cell run: status ('running', 'done', 'failed', 'interrupted') and, once done or interrupted, the result envelope — columns, a capped first page of rows, stdout/stderr (a Python cell's logs and tracebacks), media, and error. Use this when notebooks-add-cell or notebooks-update-cell returned status 'running' (the cell outlived the call's wait window): poll with the run_id, waiting a few seconds between polls, until the status is terminal, then use the envelope to decide the next step.

methodDocumentation.text: Read a run's durable state: its status, and — once done or interrupted — the result envelope (columns, first rows, stdout/stderr, media, error). Poll until terminal. Requires notebook and query read access, including after a notebook feature flag is disabled.
